title: About us
content: From the moment of incorporation more than 25 years ago, our company has come a long way of evolvement and growth from a small manufacturing enterprise to a world’s leading ventilation company. production volumes, vast geography of sales, a high share of exports, as well as by recognition from our partners throughout the world and company’s honorary membership in reputable global climate industry expert associations. Vents is a part of the international group of companies Blauberg Group, which is widely represented on all continents and has production facilities in 8 countries around the world. The company designs and implements modern technology solutions in all of its production stages, which allows producing products that best meet the expectations and needs of customers. Innovation by Vents means a holistic approach to utilizing our expertise, world’s best practices and state-of-the-art technologies in ventilation equipment production. The intellectual heart of the company is its own R&D unit with 10 specialized laboratories that employ 280 highly qualified engineers designing new engineering solutions for optimizing consumer properties of our products.

title: Maico fans – Innovative ventilation systems made in Germany
content: # MAICO in Germany. | MAICO fans – innovation, quality, and design Made in Germany  MAICO fans stands for innovative technology, the highest quality, and excellent design. The long-established family business based in Germany focuses on the development, production, and sale of modern fans and ventilation systems. With over 3,300 products and more than 200 employees, MAICO is one of Europe's leading manufacturers of ventilation components. MAICO fans – innovation, quality, and design Made in Germany. MAICO fans stands for innovative technology, the highest quality, and excellent design. # MAICO products. Products for controlled **residential ventilation** **with heat recovery** and **automatic basement dehumidification** are just as much a part of the portfolio as fans for industrial applications. MAICO offers a range of over 1,000 products in the field of **industrial ventilation**. MAICO is also a system supplier and offers a comprehensive range of accessories for all fans and applications. With the RotationVent RV 2, MAICO presents a decentralised ventilation system with flexible installation options in the external wall.

title: Blauberg Ventilatoren - Air innovation in action ▪ Make changes with Blauberg Ventilatoren
content:
Overview:
Blauberg Ventilatoren is a core brand of the Blauberg Group, offering expert solutions in the field of ventilation. Based in Germany, the company stands for innovative technology, contemporary design, and outstanding product quality. With a wide range of fans and ventilation accessories, Blauberg Ventilatoren is present in more than 20 countries. Our product portfolio includes: domestic fans and accessories, single-room ventilation systems with heat recovery, industrial fans, and custom-designed ventilation units and systems. All our products are modern, reliable, and energy-efficient, with performance verified by leading international laboratories. Thanks to our diverse offering, we meet the individual needs of customers around the world with an optimal balance of quality and price.
